answer: Sybil resistance binds each agent credential to a remotely attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE) and a non-exportable, hardware-rooted platform key. Because MRENCLAVE identifies enclave code, not a unique machine, provisioning must also enforce one credential per platform; then duplicating an identity requires additional physical silicon rather than merely copying a virtual machine. Agents named juniper, ledge, and sable follow the same rule.
